PacketDefinitions.Description: This file contains the packet definitions of the Babylon protocol: packets of the Ignies/OpenMU fork, exchanged only with the Babylon client after it announced the fork protocol. All of them use the head code 0xEE (0xFB is the ping relay of the Babylon proxy) and a sub code; the sub code ranges are reserved per system (see docs/babylon.md).

Structure.Name: CharacterClassCode
Structure.Description: The class code of a character of the character list.

Field.Name: SlotIndex
Field.Description: The slot of the character, as in the character list.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code: base class times 8 plus evolution.

Structure.Name: CreatableClass
Structure.Description: A class which the character creation offers, with the state of the server's creation rule for the account.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code: base class times 8 plus evolution.

Field.Name: State
Field.Description: 0 creatable, 1 needs another character at the level, 2 needs the Season 6 unlock (the client checks it), 3 unavailable in this world.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The creation level of the class, 0 for none.

Structure.Name: EquippedItemWide
Structure.Description: A piece of gear a player wears, in the W32 item format.

Field.Name: Slot
Field.Description: The inventory slot (0-11 of Season 6, or one of the slots after it).

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item data in the item format of the connection (see ForkWelcome.ItemFormat), zero filled to 32 bytes.

Structure.Name: SkillLevelWide
Structure.Description: A skill of the own character with its number and level.

Field.Name: SkillIndex
Field.Description: The index of the skill in the list (the Season 6 skill index, wider).

Field.Name: SkillNumber
Field.Description: The skill number.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The level of a master or tree skill, else 0.

Structure.Name: MasterSkillWide
Structure.Description: A learned master skill, by its number instead of the index of the Season 6 client tree.

Field.Name: SkillNumber
Field.Description: The skill number.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The level.

Field.Name: DisplayValue
Field.Description: The value at the level.

Field.Name: DisplayValueOfNextLevel
Field.Description: The value at the next level.

Structure.Name: EnhanceTreeSkill
Structure.Description: A learned skill of the skill enhancement tree.

Field.Name: SkillNumber
Field.Description: The skill number of the node or passive.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The points in it.

Structure.Name: AbilityCoreCard
Structure.Description: A card in a slot of the Ability Enhancement Core.

Field.Name: Slot
Field.Description: 0 the extra damage slot, 1-3 the skill slots, 4-18 the option slots (rows of five: blue, green, purple), 19-21 the elite slots.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The card in the W32 item format: its level is the card level, its option the card option.

Structure.Name: EliteZone
Structure.Description: An elite zone of the map.

Field.Name: Element
Field.Description: 1 fire, 2 water, 3 earth, 4 wind, 5 darkness.

Field.Name: X1
Field.Description: The lowest x coordinate of the area.

Field.Name: Y1
Field.Description: The lowest y coordinate of the area.

Field.Name: X2
Field.Description: The highest x coordinate of the area.

Field.Name: Y2
Field.Description: The highest y coordinate of the area.

Field.Name: CanEnter
Field.Description: 1 when the character meets the entry rule.

Structure.Name: GremoryCaseItem
Structure.Description: A reward in a gremory case.

Field.Name: Slot
Field.Description: The slot of the reward in the case, which a claim refers to.

Field.Name: ExpiresAt
Field.Description: The point in time at which the reward expires, in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item in the W32 item format.

Structure.Name: RuudShopItem
Structure.Description: An item of the Ruud shop.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: The index of the item in the shop, which a purchase refers to.

Field.Name: Count
Field.Description: The count (durability) of the item; 0 for the durability of its definition.

Field.Name: Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0: the item may get luck; bit 1: the item may get the additional option.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price in Ruud.

Structure.Name: SocketedErrtel
Structure.Description: An errtel in a socket of a pentagram, with its rank options.

Field.Name: ErrtelNumber
Field.Description: The item number of the errtel (group 12).

Field.Name: RankOptions
Field.Description: Five pairs of option number and level, by rank; 0xFF 0 for a rank the errtel doesn't have. The option numbers are the S21 errtel option indexes, as in the W32 slots of an errtel.

Structure.Name: MuunInventoryItem
Structure.Description: An item of the Muun inventory.

Field.Name: Slot
Field.Description: 0 the main Muun, 1 the sub Muun, 2-101 the bag.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item in the W32 item format.

Structure.Name: MuunOptionState
Structure.Description: The option of an equipped Muun.

Field.Name: Slot
Field.Description: 0 the main Muun, 1 the sub Muun.

Field.Name: OptionType
Field.Description: The option type of the Season 21 data (MuunOption.xml OptionType).

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The value, raised by the additional option while it lasts.

Field.Name: Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0: it applies now (its condition is met). Bit 1: the additional option raises it.

Structure.Name: MuunExchangeOfferEntry
Structure.Description: An offer of the Muun exchange NPC.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: The index of the offer, which the exchange request refers to.

Field.Name: TargetNumber
Field.Description: The Muun which the evolution stone evolves (item group 16); 0xFFFF for none.

Structure.Name: SoulConverterMission
Structure.Description: A soul mission of a monster soul converter.

Field.Name: MapNumber
Field.Description: The map of the monster.

Field.Name: MonsterNumber
Field.Description: The monster whose souls count.

Field.Name: Souls
Field.Description: The souls absorbed so far.

Field.Name: RequiredSouls
Field.Description: The souls the mission needs.

Structure.Name: RankingEntry
Structure.Description: A character of a ranking page.

Field.Name: Rank
Field.Description: The rank, from 1.

Field.Name: Name
Field.Description: The name of the character.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code of the character (docs/babylon.md, "Class code").

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The value the ranking orders by.

Structure.Name: HuntingRecordDay
Structure.Description: The hunting of one day on one map.

Field.Name: Day
Field.Description: The start of the day (UTC), in seconds since 1970-01-01.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: The seconds the character spent on the map.

Field.Name: Kills
Field.Description: The monsters the character killed.

Field.Name: Experience
Field.Description: The experience the character gained by kills, normal and master.

Field.Name: Damage
Field.Description: The damage the character dealt to monsters.

Structure.Name: SeasonPassMission
Structure.Description: The progress of a daily mission of the season pass.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: The mission index (S21 MUPassMissionText).

Field.Name: Completions
Field.Description: How often the mission was completed today.

Field.Name: Progress
Field.Description: The progress towards the next completion.

Structure.Name: GuideQuestRewardItem
Structure.Description: An item reward of a guide quest step.

Structure.Name: LabyrinthGoalState
Structure.Description: A goal of the mission of a room of the Labyrinth of Dimensions and its progress.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: The kind: 1 kill, 2 kill the monsters of the room in time, 3 damage, 4 MU Helper seconds, 5 kill the monsters of the room in time without a health potion, 6 the same without a mana potion, 7 experience (counts as met).

Field.Name: Target
Field.Description: The target: monsters (1), minutes (2, 5, 6), damage (3), seconds (4) or experience (7).

Field.Name: Progress
Field.Description: The progress since the mission (re)started: the kills for 1, 2, 5 and 6, the damage for 3, the seconds for 4.

Structure.Name: ArcaObeliskState
Structure.Description: An obelisk of the Arca War as the player sees it.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: The index of the obelisk (1-3 in the data).

Field.Name: Element
Field.Description: The element of this war: 1 fire, 2 water, 3 earth, 4 wind, 5 darkness.

Field.Name: HealthPercent
Field.Description: The health in percent; 0 while the obelisk is destroyed and comes back.

Field.Name: AuraMask
Field.Description: The auras members of the player's guild stand on: bit i for aura i.

Field.Name: IsOpen
Field.Description: The shield is down for the player's guild, which may destroy the obelisk.

Field.Name: OwnerGuildId
Field.Description: The guild which holds the obelisk, 0 for none.

Structure.Name: IllusionTempleStoneState
Structure.Description: A Captured Stone Statue of the renewed Illusion Temple.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: The index of the stone, 0-9 (NPC 659-668).

Field.Name: Holder
Field.Description: The team which sealed the hollow into it: 0 none, 1 allied forces, 2 illusion forces.

Packet.Name: ForkHello
Packet.SentWhen: After the login succeeded, when the client logged in with the version of the Babylon client.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with the ForkWelcome which tells the client the wire format and the features which are active.

Field.Name: ClientWire
Field.Description: The version of the Babylon protocol which the client speaks.

Field.Name: WantedFeatures
Field.Description: A bit per feature (see docs/babylon.md) which the client wants to use on this world.

Field.Name: ClientBuild
Field.Description: The build number of the client, for the logs.

Packet.Name: ForkWelcome
Packet.SentWhen: After the client sent the ForkHello.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client switches to the wire formats and features of the fork. When it does not arrive, the client reconnects with the Season 6 protocol.

Field.Name: ServerWire
Field.Description: The version of the Babylon protocol which the server speaks.

Field.Name: ActiveFeatures
Field.Description: The wanted features which the server supports and uses for this connection.

Field.Name: ItemFormat
Field.Description: The item data format of every item of this connection: 0 = Season 6 (12 bytes), 1 = W32 (32 bytes).

Field.Name: ClassEncoding
Field.Description: The class encoding of the Babylon packets: 0 = Season 6 (5 bits), 1 = class code (base class times 8 plus evolution).

Field.Name: MaximumLevel
Field.Description: The normal level cap of the world.

Field.Name: MaximumStars
Field.Description: The maximum number of stars of the world, 0 when it has none.

Packet.Name: ForkFeaturesChanged
Packet.SentWhen: After the active features of the connection changed while the client is connected.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client turns the features on or off.

Field.Name: ActiveFeatures
Field.Description: The features which are active from now on.

Packet.Name: CreateCharacterWide
Packet.SentWhen: The player creates a character of any class, on the character selection screen.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server creates the character and answers with the CharacterCreatedWide, or with the character creation failure of Season 6.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code: base class times 8 plus evolution.

Packet.Name: CharacterCreatedWide
Packet.SentWhen: After the server created a character which the Babylon client asked for.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the new character in its slot.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code: base class times 8 plus evolution.

Packet.Name: CharacterClassCodes
Packet.SentWhen: Right after the character list, to a Babylon client.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client takes the class of each character from its code instead of the 5 bits of the Season 6 appearance.

Packet.Name: CreatableClasses
Packet.SentWhen: Right after the class codes of the character list, to a Babylon client.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client offers the classes in the character creation and greys out those the server refuses.

Packet.Name: PlayerAppearanceWide
Packet.SentWhen: Right after the Season 6 packet which adds a player to the view of a Babylon client.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client takes the class of the player from its code and its gear from the wide item data, instead of the 5 bit class and the Season 6 appearance.

Field.Name: PlayerId
Field.Description: The id of the player, as in the Season 6 packet.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code: base class times 8 plus evolution.

Packet.Name: AppearanceChangedWide
Packet.SentWhen: A player in the view of a Babylon client put on or took off a piece of gear.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client updates the gear of the player.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code of the player, so an evolution shows too.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item data in the item format of the connection, zero filled to 32 bytes; all 0xFF when the slot got empty.

Packet.Name: EnhanceTreeState
Packet.SentWhen: With the skill list, to a fourth or fifth evolution of a world with the skill enhancement tree.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client fills its skill enhancement tree window.

Field.Name: FreePoints
Field.Description: The free points.

Field.Name: SpentPoints
Field.Description: The points spent in the tree.

Packet.Name: EnhanceTreeAddPoint
Packet.SentWhen: The player adds a point to a node or passive of the skill enhancement tree.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server checks the node and the points and answers with EnhanceTreeAddPointResult.

Field.Name: SkillNumber
Field.Description: The skill number of the node or passive.

Packet.Name: EnhanceTreeAddPointResult
Packet.SentWhen: After the player asked to add a point to the skill enhancement tree.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the new level and the free points, or why the point was refused.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 added, 1 no tree, 2 unknown node, 3 requirement missing, 4 not enough points, 5 maximum reached.

Field.Name: SkillNumber
Field.Description: The skill number of the node.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The level of the node after the request.

Field.Name: FreePoints
Field.Description: The free points after the request.

Packet.Name: AbilityCoreState
Packet.SentWhen: When a fifth evolution enters a map while the Ability Enhancement Core is on, and after every successful core action.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client fills its Ability Enhancement Core window.

Field.Name: OpenSlots
Field.Description: The open slots, bit n for the slot n.

Field.Name: ActiveSlots
Field.Description: The slots whose card takes effect, bit n for the slot n.

Packet.Name: AbilityCoreRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player puts a card into the core, takes one out, levels one up or reduces one into stones.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server checks and does it, and answers with AbilityCoreResponse; after a success also with AbilityCoreState and the inventory packets.

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: 0 insert (inventory slot into core slot), 1 remove (core slot into inventory slot, 0xFF the first free one), 2 level up (the card of the inventory slot, or of the core slot when it is 0xFF), 3 reduce (the card of the inventory slot).

Packet.Name: AbilityCoreResponse
Packet.SentWhen: After an AbilityCoreRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the result; on success the card (or the stones of a reduction) at its new place.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 done, 1 off, 2 not a fifth evolution, 3 no item, 4 not a card (or no level up / reduction for it), 5 slot locked, 6 wrong slot (kind, row color or class), 7 slot occupied, 8 requirement missing (the fourth evolution skill, or the five option cards of the row), 9 inventory full, 10 highest level, 11 not enough cards, 12 not enough zen, 13 not enough stones, 14 elite level above the row.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The card after the action (the stones after a reduction) in the W32 item format; 0xFF when there is none.

Packet.Name: MasterSkillListWide
Packet.SentWhen: With the master skill list, to a Babylon client.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client places the master skills in its tree by their numbers; the Season 6 list identifies them by a slot of its own client tree, which the classes after Season 6 do not have.

Field.Name: MasterLevelUpPoints
Field.Description: The free master points.

Packet.Name: SkillListWide
Packet.SentWhen: When the own character enters the world, to a Babylon client.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the skills. The Season 6 list counts them in a byte of a C1 packet, so it holds at most 62; a fourth or fifth evolution with its tree skills has more.

Packet.Name: ClassEvolved
Packet.SentWhen: A character in the view of a Babylon client (or its own) evolved into its next class.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the evolution and the body of the new class.

Field.Name: ClassCode
Field.Description: The class code of the new class.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: 0 quest, 1 game master, 2 item.

Packet.Name: GuideQuestState
Packet.SentWhen: The character entered a map, asked for its guide quest, accepted or completed a step, or the progress of its step changed.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the step in the quest guide window and its line on the quest tracker.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: 0 the class has no guide quests, 1 the step can be accepted, 2 accepted, 3 accepted and its objective is met, 4 the step needs a higher level, 5 every step is done.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: The answer to the request which caused it: 0 none, 1 accepted, 2 completed, 3 the objective isn't met, 4 the level is too low.

Field.Name: StepNumber
Field.Description: The number of the step (S21Emu QuestGuide.txt); 0 when there is none.

Field.Name: StepIndex
Field.Description: The place of the step in the chain of the class, from 1.

Field.Name: StepCount
Field.Description: The number of steps in the chain of the class.

Field.Name: Objective
Field.Description: 1 collect items, 2 hunt monsters, 3 reach a level, 4 finish a class quest, 5 go to a spot.

Field.Name: Target
Field.Description: The monster number, the level, the class quest number (1 second class, 2 hero status, 6 third class) or the item group.

Field.Name: TargetNumber
Field.Description: The item number of a collect objective.

Field.Name: RequiredCount
Field.Description: The kills, items or level the objective asks for; 1 for a move or a class quest.

Field.Name: Progress
Field.Description: How far the objective is: kills, items carried, the level, or 1 when the spot was reached or the class quest is done.

Field.Name: MapNumber
Field.Description: The map of the spot: where to go, or where the monsters are.

Field.Name: Gate
Field.Description: The warp gate of the data which leads near the spot.

Field.Name: Name
Field.Description: The name of the step, UTF-8, zero padded.

Packet.Name: GuideQuestRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player opens the quest guide, or accepts or completes its step.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with GuideQuestState; a request for another step than the current one only gets the state.

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: 0 show the state, 1 accept, 2 complete.

Field.Name: StepNumber
Field.Description: The step the client shows.

Packet.Name: EvolutionQuestState
Packet.SentWhen: The character entered a map, completed a quest, or its experience got held at the level of its next evolution.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows what the next evolution asks for, and that the experience is held.

Field.Name: NextEvolution
Field.Description: The evolution of the next class (3 fourth, 4 fifth), 0xFF when no evolution quest leads further.

Field.Name: RuleMet
Field.Description: The character meets the level rule of the next evolution and may start its quest.

Field.Name: ExperienceHeld
Field.Description: The character gains no experience until it evolves.

Field.Name: LevelKey
Field.Description: What the required level counts: 1 level plus master level, 2 power level (level plus the worth of the stars), 3 Season 21 total level.

Field.Name: RequiredLevel
Field.Description: The level which the next evolution asks for.

Packet.Name: EliteZones
Packet.SentWhen: When the own character enters a map with elite zones, on a world with the elite zones.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client marks the zones on the map and the minimap.

Packet.Name: FieldBossState
Packet.SentWhen: When the own character enters the map of a field boss, and when the boss spawns, changes its stage, loses a tenth of its health, is killed or the battle ends.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the boss state, e.g. the health bar, the respawn timer and the light of the boss zone.

Field.Name: BossNumber
Field.Description: The monster number of the boss itself (the last stage).

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: 0 waiting, 1 alive, 2 in a fight, 3 defeated.

Field.Name: HealthPercent
Field.Description: The health of the monster of the current stage, 0 when none lives.

Field.Name: SecondsLeft
Field.Description: The seconds to the spawn (waiting), to the end of the battle (in a fight) or to the move out of the arena (defeated); 0 when unknown.

Packet.Name: ItemExpired
Packet.SentWhen: An item of the character or its account expired and was removed (fork worlds with item expiry).
Packet.CausedReaction: The client tells the player which item expired. The removal itself is sent as usual (item removed, gremory case expired).

Field.Name: Storage
Field.Description: 0 inventory, 1 vault, 2 gremory case of the character, 3 gremory case of the account.

Field.Name: Slot
Field.Description: The slot of the item in its storage.

Packet.Name: MagicEffectStatusWide
Packet.SentWhen: A magic effect numbered past 255 (a later season's effect, such as the Blessing of Eunice 447) was added to or removed from the own player; the Season 6 packet (07) carries the number in a byte.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the effect's icon with its remaining time, or hides it.

Field.Name: SecondsLeft
Field.Description: The remaining seconds of the effect, 0 when it's removed or its duration isn't sent.

Packet.Name: MuunInventoryList
Packet.SentWhen: When the character enters a map while the Muun system is on.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the Muun inventory.

Packet.Name: MuunItemMove
Packet.SentWhen: The player moves an item between the inventory and the Muun inventory, or within the Muun inventory; slots 0 and 1 equip a Muun.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server moves it and answers with MuunItemMoveResponse.

Field.Name: FromStorage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Field.Name: ToStorage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Packet.Name: MuunItemMoveResponse
Packet.SentWhen: After a MuunItemMove.
Packet.CausedReaction: On success, the client shows the item at its new place; the inventory side also gets the Season 6 item removed / item added packets.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 done, 1 off, 2 no item, 3 wrong material, 4 highest level, 5 level too low, 6 no evolution, 7 not enough items, 8 not at the exchange NPC, 9 no free slot, 10 riding not allowed here, 11 no mount, 12 slot occupied, 13 not a Muun, 14 the same Muun is equipped, 15 slot locked (the hero slot before the highest level, or no hero Muun).

Field.Name: FromStorage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Field.Name: ToStorage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item in the W32 item format; 0xFF when there is none.

Packet.Name: MuunRideRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player mounts or dismounts the Muun of the main slot (Ctrl+Z in Season 21).
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with MuunActionResponse (action 6) and shows MuunAppearance to the player and the players around.

Field.Name: Ride
Field.Description: True to mount, false to dismount.

Packet.Name: MuunItemUse
Packet.SentWhen: The player drops an item on a Muun item: a Muun of level 1 on the same Muun (level up), an evolution stone on a Muun (evolve), a Muun or an evolution stone on a Muun energy converter (charge), a jewel of life on a Muun (restore).
Packet.CausedReaction: The server uses up the source item, changes the target item and answers with MuunActionResponse.

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: 1 level up, 2 evolve, 3 charge energy, 4 restore.

Field.Name: SourceStorage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Field.Name: TargetStorage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Packet.Name: MuunActionResponse
Packet.SentWhen: After a MuunItemUse, a MuunExchangeRequest or a MuunRideRequest, and when an equipped Muun lost health (action 4).
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the changed or created item at its place.

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: 1 level up, 2 evolve, 3 charge energy, 4 restore or health changed, 5 exchange, 6 ride.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 done, 1 off, 2 no item, 3 wrong material, 4 highest level, 5 level too low, 6 no evolution, 7 not enough items, 8 not at the exchange NPC, 9 no free slot, 10 riding not allowed here, 11 no mount, 12 slot occupied, 13 not a Muun, 14 the same Muun is equipped, 15 slot locked (the hero slot before the highest level, or no hero Muun).

Field.Name: Storage
Field.Description: 0 the inventory, 1 the Muun inventory.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item in the W32 item format; 0xFF when there is none.

Packet.Name: MuunAppearance
Packet.SentWhen: When a player with a Muun comes into view, and when the main Muun of a player changes or it mounts or dismounts.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the Muun beside the player, or the player riding it.

Field.Name: ItemGroup
Field.Description: 16; 0xFF when the player has no main Muun.

Field.Name: ItemLevel
Field.Description: The level of the Muun.

Packet.Name: MuunOptions
Packet.SentWhen: When the character enters a map, and when an option of an equipped Muun changes (equip, level, evolution, its condition, the end of the additional option).
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the options of the equipped Muuns and which of them apply now.

Packet.Name: MuunExchangeList
Packet.SentWhen: The player talked to the Muun exchange NPC (Monica, 682).
Packet.CausedReaction: The client opens the exchange with its offers.

Packet.Name: MuunExchangeRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player takes an offer of the Muun exchange NPC.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server takes the items, puts the evolution stone into the bag of the Muun inventory and answers with MuunActionResponse (action 5).

Packet.Name: MuunSkillUsed
Packet.SentWhen: The Muun of a player in view hit a monster with its attack skill.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the attack of the Muun and the damage on the monster.

Packet.Name: GremoryCaseList
Packet.SentWhen: When the character enters a map, and on request, for each of the two cases.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the rewards of the case.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 the case of the character, 1 the case of the account.

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: The number of rewards the case holds.

Packet.Name: GremoryCaseItemAdded
Packet.SentWhen: A reward was put into a gremory case of the character or its account.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client adds the reward to the case and tells the player about it.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 the case of the character, 1 the case of the account.

Field.Name: ExpiresAt
Field.Description: The point in time at which the reward expires, in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

Field.Name: ItemData
Field.Description: The item in the W32 item format.

Packet.Name: GremoryCaseClaim
Packet.SentWhen: The player wants to take a reward of a gremory case into the inventory.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server moves the reward into the inventory and answers with GremoryCaseClaimResponse.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 the case of the character, 1 the case of the account.

Packet.Name: GremoryCaseClaimResponse
Packet.SentWhen: After a claim of a reward of a gremory case.
Packet.CausedReaction: On success, the client removes the reward from the case; the item appears in the inventory by the usual packet.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 the case of the character, 1 the case of the account.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 claimed, 1 inventory full, 2 no such reward, 3 expired, 4 the case is off.

Packet.Name: GremoryCaseItemExpired
Packet.SentWhen: A reward of a gremory case expired before it was claimed.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client removes the reward from the case.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 the case of the character, 1 the case of the account.

Packet.Name: GremoryCaseListRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The client wants the content of the gremory cases again, e.g. when the player opens the window.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server sends GremoryCaseList for both cases.

Packet.Name: RuudChanged
Packet.SentWhen: When the character enters a map, when the Ruud shop opens, and when the Ruud of the character changed.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the Ruud of the character.

Field.Name: Ruud
Field.Description: The Ruud of the character.

Field.Name: Change
Field.Description: The change which led to it, signed (two's complement); 0 when it is just shown.

Packet.Name: RuudShopList
Packet.SentWhen: The player talked to the NPC of the Ruud shop (Priest James).
Packet.CausedReaction: The client opens the Ruud shop with the items which the class of the character may buy.

Packet.Name: RuudShopBuy
Packet.SentWhen: The player wants to buy an item of the Ruud shop.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with RuudShopBuyResponse.

Field.Name: Index
Field.Description: The index of the item, as in RuudShopList.

Packet.Name: RuudShopBuyResponse
Packet.SentWhen: After a purchase in the Ruud shop.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the result; the item appears in the inventory by the usual packet.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 bought, 1 not enough Ruud, 2 inventory full, 3 no such item for the class, 4 the shop is closed.

Field.Name: Ruud
Field.Description: The Ruud of the character after the purchase.

Packet.Name: MerchantStoreTabs
Packet.SentWhen: After the item list of a merchant whose store has more than one tab, and before the item list of another tab.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the tabs; the next store item list (C2 31) holds the items of the active tab.

Field.Name: ActiveTab
Field.Description: The tab whose items the next store item list holds; 0 is the first.

Packet.Name: MerchantStoreTabSelect
Packet.SentWhen: The player selected another tab of the store of the opened merchant.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with MerchantStoreTabs and the store item list of the tab; purchases then refer to its items.

Packet.Name: ErrtelSocketRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player puts an errtel into a socket of a pentagram, or takes one out.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server checks the pentagram, the errtel and the socket, moves the errtel and answers with PentagramResult.

Field.Name: Mode
Field.Description: 0 inserts the errtel of ErrtelSlot, 1 takes the errtel of SocketIndex out.

Field.Name: PentagramSlot
Field.Description: The inventory slot of the pentagram (also the equipped slot 236).

Field.Name: ErrtelSlot
Field.Description: The inventory slot of the errtel to insert; ignored when taking out.

Field.Name: SocketIndex
Field.Description: The socket of the pentagram, 0-4 (the socket of the errtel's kind: anger, blessing, integrity, divinity, radiance).

Packet.Name: PentagramResult
Packet.SentWhen: After an ErrtelSocketRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the result; the changed items come with the usual item packets.

Field.Name: Mode
Field.Description: The mode of the request: 0 insert, 1 take out.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 success, 1 failed (taking out destroyed the errtel), 2 refused (wrong item, element, socket, or no space).

Packet.Name: ElementalDamage
Packet.SentWhen: A hit of the own character, or a hit on it, deals elemental damage, on a world with the elements.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the elemental damage beside the hit, in the color of its element. The damage is a part of the hit's damage, not an extra.

Field.Name: TargetId
Field.Description: The id of the object which took the damage, as in the Season 6 hit packet.

Field.Name: Element
Field.Description: 1 fire, 2 water, 3 earth, 4 wind, 5 darkness.

Packet.Name: PentagramErrtelsRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The client needs the errtels in the sockets of a pentagram, e.g. for its tooltip.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with PentagramErrtels.

Field.Name: PentagramSlot
Field.Description: The inventory slot of the pentagram.

Packet.Name: PentagramErrtels
Packet.SentWhen: After a PentagramErrtelsRequest, and after an errtel was put into or taken out of the pentagram.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the errtels of the pentagram's sockets.

Packet.Name: ElementInfo
Packet.SentWhen: After an ElementInfoRequest, and after an errtel was put into or taken out of the equipped pentagram.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the elemental stats of the own character in its character window.

Field.Name: Element
Field.Description: 0 none, 1 fire, 2 water, 3 earth, 4 wind, 5 darkness.

Field.Name: DamageMin
Field.Description: The minimum elemental damage with its bonuses.

Field.Name: DamageMax
Field.Description: The maximum elemental damage with its bonuses.

Field.Name: CriticalChance
Field.Description: The elemental critical damage chance in percent.

Field.Name: DodgeChance
Field.Description: The elemental perfect dodge chance in percent.

Packet.Name: ElementInfoRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The client needs the elemental stats of the own character, e.g. after an equipment change or to open the character window.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with ElementInfo.

Packet.Name: MiningRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player mines the next stage of a mining spot, or stops and collects what the spot gave so far.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with MiningResult.

Field.Name: NpcId
Field.Description: The object id of the mining spot.

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: 0 mine the next stage, 1 stop and collect.

Packet.Name: MiningResult
Packet.SentWhen: The player talked to a mining spot, mined a stage or collected.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the mining window: the stage, the pending reward or the loss.

Field.Name: NpcId
Field.Description: The object id of the mining spot.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 opened, 1 stage mined, 2 failed (the pending reward is lost), 3 collected, 4 no pickaxe in the hands, 5 pickaxe worn out, 6 no spot in reach, 7 another player mines the spot, 8 mining is off.

Field.Name: Stage
Field.Description: The stage reached, 0 before the first.

Field.Name: ItemCount
Field.Description: The items the stage gives (pending), or the collected ones.

Field.Name: BonusCount
Field.Description: The bonus items of the jackpot of the last stage, 0 when none.

Packet.Name: SoulConverterState
Packet.SentWhen: The character enters a map, the state changes (a soul is absorbed, a mission is done, the week ends) and on request.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the active monster soul converter with its missions.

Field.Name: Tier
Field.Description: The tier of the active converter, 1 to 5; 0 when none is active.

Field.Name: PurchasesLeft
Field.Description: The converters the character may still activate this week.

Field.Name: ExpiresAt
Field.Description: The point in time at which the converter expires, in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC; 0 when none.

Packet.Name: SoulConverterRewardRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player chooses the reward of a completed monster soul converter.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server delivers the reward and answers with SoulConverterResult.

Field.Name: RewardKind
Field.Description: 0 Ruud, 1 jewels, 2 elemental options, 3 accessory.

Packet.Name: SoulConverterResult
Packet.SentWhen: After a SoulConverterRewardRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the result.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 rewarded, 1 missions not done, 2 no active converter, 3 the reward kind is not offered at this tier, 4 the converter is off, 5 the reward could not be delivered.

Packet.Name: SoulConverterStateRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The client opens the monster soul converter window.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with SoulConverterState.

Packet.Name: EventStateRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The client shows the entry of a Season 21 event of a game level, e.g. its entry window or its row under the event timers.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with EventState: open with the seconds until the entrance closes, playing, or closed with the seconds until the next start.

Field.Name: EventType
Field.Description: The mini game type of the server (docs/babylon.md, "Events").

Packet.Name: RankingPage
Packet.SentWhen: After a RankingRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the page of the ranking.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 total level, 1 monster kills of the week, 2 hunting experience of the week.

Field.Name: Page
Field.Description: The page, from 0.

Field.Name: OwnRank
Field.Description: The rank of the own character, 0 when it is not ranked.

Packet.Name: HuntingRecordList
Packet.SentWhen: After a HuntingRecordRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the hunting record of the map, one row a day, newest first.

Packet.Name: SeasonPassState
Packet.SentWhen: The character enters a map, the pass gains experience or a level, a reward is claimed, and on request.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the season pass.

Field.Name: Season
Field.Description: The number of the running season, 0 when none runs.

Field.Name: EndsAt
Field.Description: The end of the season, in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The pass level, 0 before the first.

Field.Name: Experience
Field.Description: The pass experience.

Field.Name: Passes
Field.Description: Bit 0 the free pass, bit 1 the gold pass, bit 2 the premium pass.

Field.Name: ClaimedFree
Field.Description: One bit per level (bit 0 = level 1) whose free reward was claimed.

Field.Name: ClaimedGold
Field.Description: The same for the gold pass.

Field.Name: ClaimedPremium
Field.Description: The same for the premium pass.

Packet.Name: RankingRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player opens a page of a ranking.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with RankingPage.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 total level, 1 monster kills of the week, 2 hunting experience of the week.

Field.Name: Page
Field.Description: The page, from 0.

Packet.Name: HuntingRecordRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player opens the hunting record of a map.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with HuntingRecordList.

Field.Name: MapNumber
Field.Description: The map; 0xFFFF for the current one.

Packet.Name: SeasonPassClaim
Packet.SentWhen: The player claims the reward of a pass level.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server delivers it into the gremory case and answers with SeasonPassClaimResult.

Field.Name: Pass
Field.Description: 0 free, 1 gold, 2 premium.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The pass level of the reward.

Packet.Name: SeasonPassClaimResult
Packet.SentWhen: After a SeasonPassClaim.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the result.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 claimed, 1 level not reached, 2 already claimed, 3 the pass is not owned, 4 no reward at this level, 5 the reward could not be delivered, 6 the season pass is off.

Packet.Name: SeasonPassStateRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The client opens the season pass window.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with SeasonPassState.

Packet.Name: HelperPlusRules
Packet.SentWhen: The character enters a map while the helper plus rules are on, and after a HelperPlusModeRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client limits its helper settings to the ranges and shows whether the helper and its plus mode may run.

Field.Name: Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 this map has hunting zones of the plus mode, bit 1 the character may use the plus mode, bit 2 the plus mode is on.

Field.Name: PlusMinimumLevel
Field.Description: The total level (level + master level) the plus mode needs.

Field.Name: HuntRange
Field.Description: The largest hunting range of the normal helper, in tiles.

Field.Name: PickupRange
Field.Description: The largest pick-up range of the normal helper, in tiles.

Field.Name: PlusHuntRange
Field.Description: The largest hunting range of the plus mode, in tiles.

Field.Name: PlusPickupRange
Field.Description: The largest pick-up range of the plus mode, in tiles.

Field.Name: PlusCostPercent
Field.Description: The cost of the plus mode in percent of the normal helper cost.

Packet.Name: HelperPlusMoveRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The helper plus moves the character to a hunting zone.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server checks the zone and the warp rules, moves the character and answers with HelperPlusMoveResult.

Field.Name: ZoneIndex
Field.Description: The index of the hunting zone (S21 MuHelperPlus.xml, Info Index).

Packet.Name: HelperPlusMoveResult
Packet.SentWhen: After a HelperPlusMoveRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client continues the helper in the zone, or stops it.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 moved, 1 unknown zone, 2 level too low for the zone, 3 not enough money, 4 the plus mode is not on, 5 the helper plus rules are off, 6 the character can not move now.

Packet.Name: HelperPlusModeRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player switches the plus mode of the helper on or off.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with HelperPlusRules.

Packet.Name: EventState
Packet.SentWhen: When the state of a Season 21 event or party instance changes for the own character (entrance opened or closed, the game started or ended), and when the character talks to its entrance NPC.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the entry window or the state and timer of the event.

Field.Name: EventType
Field.Description: The mini game type of the server (docs/babylon.md, "Events").

Field.Name: State
Field.Description: 0 open (entrance), 1 closed, 2 playing, 3 ended.

Field.Name: SecondsLeft
Field.Description: The seconds until the next state; 0 when unknown.

Packet.Name: EventEnterRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The player wants to enter a Season 21 event or party instance of a game level, e.g. by the entry window.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server checks the entry rules and warps the character into the event, or answers with EventEnterResult.

Packet.Name: EventScore
Packet.SentWhen: While a Season 21 event runs: when the score, the round or the rank of the own character changes, and once a second for the timer.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client updates the score window of the event.

Field.Name: Round
Field.Description: The round, floor or stage of the event, 0 when it has none.

Field.Name: Score
Field.Description: The points, or the damage for the boss battle.

Field.Name: Rank
Field.Description: The rank of the own character (or its party), starting at 1; 0 when unranked.

Packet.Name: EventResult
Packet.SentWhen: When a Season 21 event or party instance ended for the own character.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the result window; item rewards arrive in the gremory case or the inventory by their own packets.

Field.Name: Experience
Field.Description: The experience of the reward, at most 4294967295.

Packet.Name: EventEnterResult
Packet.SentWhen: When the entry into a Season 21 event or party instance failed.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows why; the server also tells it in words.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: The enter result of the server: 0 success, 1 failed, 2 not open, 3 level too high, 4 level too low, 5 full, 6 not enough money, 7 player killers can not enter (docs/babylon.md, "Events").

Packet.Name: LabyrinthLeague
Packet.SentWhen: When the character enters the Labyrinth of Dimensions and when its run ended, while the plugin of the labyrinth league is on.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the tier, the rank in the group and the points of the week of the character.

Field.Name: Tier
Field.Description: The tier: 0 Bronze, 1 Silver, 2 Gold, 3 Legend.

Field.Name: Rank
Field.Description: The rank in the group of the current week, 0 when the character has no points this week.

Field.Name: GroupSize
Field.Description: The number of characters of the group.

Field.Name: Day
Field.Description: The kind of the day: 0 no league day, 1 the first day of a week, 2 a play day, 3 the reward day.

Field.Name: Points
Field.Description: The points of the current week.

Field.Name: FloorsToday
Field.Description: The number of floors cleared today.

Packet.Name: LabyrinthRoomBoard
Packet.SentWhen: When a floor of the Labyrinth of Dimensions starts in its entrance room, after each move to another room and when the mission of the room is done, while the plugin of the labyrinth rooms is on.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client draws the area of the other map as the room, its portals and the board of the floor.

Field.Name: PathNumber
Field.Description: The number of the path of the floor (1-30 in the data).

Field.Name: RoomIndex
Field.Description: The room the character is in: row * 10 + column.

Field.Name: MapNumber
Field.Description: The map whose area the room shows.

Field.Name: AreaType
Field.Description: The kind of room: 1 entrance, 2 normal, 3 mission, 4 main mission.

Field.Name: AreaNumber
Field.Description: The number of the area (EventMaps ID of the data).

Field.Name: PortalTop
Field.Description: The portal to the row above: 0 closed, 1 open, 2 opens with the mission of the room.

Field.Name: Discovered
Field.Description: The rooms the character opened on this floor: bit (index % 8) of byte (index / 8).

Field.Name: Cleared
Field.Description: The rooms whose mission is done, in the same bit order.

Packet.Name: LabyrinthRoomMission
Packet.SentWhen: When the character enters a room of the Labyrinth of Dimensions, when the progress of its mission changes (damage and helper time at most once a second) and when the mission is done.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the mission of the room and its progress.

Packet.Name: LabyrinthRoomMoveRequest
Packet.SentWhen: The character walked into a portal of its room in the Labyrinth of Dimensions.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server moves the character into the next room (LabyrinthRoomBoard and LabyrinthRoomMission follow) and answers with LabyrinthRoomMoveResult.

Field.Name: Direction
Field.Description: 0 top, 1 bottom, 2 left, 3 right.

Packet.Name: LabyrinthRoomMoveResult
Packet.SentWhen: After a LabyrinthRoomMoveRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client tells why the portal doesn't open, if it doesn't.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 moved, 1 no portal or no room behind it, 2 the mission of the room isn't done, 3 not playing the rooms of a labyrinth.

Packet.Name: ArcaWarRequest
Packet.SentWhen: A guild master registers the guild for the Arca War, a member registers, or a registered member enters the war.
Packet.CausedReaction: The server answers with ArcaWarRequestResponse; an entry warps the character to the spawns of its guild.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: 0 register the guild (master), 1 register as a member, 2 enter the war.

Packet.Name: ArcaWarRequestResponse
Packet.SentWhen: After an ArcaWarRequest.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client tells the result.

Field.Name: Result
Field.Description: 0 success, 1 not open, 2 no guild, 3 not the guild master, 4 already registered, 5 too many guilds, 6 guild not registered, 7 too many members, 8 not registered, 9 not enough Signs of Lord.

Packet.Name: ArcaWarStageState
Packet.SentWhen: To every player when the stage of the Arca War changes, after a request and when a character enters the world while the war isn't closed.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the stage and its countdown.

Field.Name: Stage
Field.Description: 0 closed, 1 guild master registration, 2 member registration, 3 waiting, 4 war, 5 closing.

Field.Name: Guilds
Field.Description: The registered guilds.

Field.Name: Registered
Field.Description: The character is registered.

Field.Name: SecondsLeft
Field.Description: The seconds until the next stage.

Field.Name: Points
Field.Description: The points of the character in this war.

Packet.Name: ArcaWarObelisks
Packet.SentWhen: Once a second during the Arca War, to the players on its maps.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the obelisks, their holders, health, auras and shields.

Packet.Name: IllusionTempleLeagueState
Packet.SentWhen: When a character of a guild enters the world on a league day, when a league match starts and after it ended, while the plugin of the Illusion Temple League is on.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the league of the guild: the stage of the day, the rank, the entries and the qualification.

Field.Name: Stage
Field.Description: The stage of the day: 0 no league day, 1 eliminations, 2 semi-finals, 3 final, 4 reward day.

Field.Name: Rank
Field.Description: The rank of the guild in the eliminations of the month, 0 when it played none.

Field.Name: GuildEntries
Field.Description: The elimination matches the guild played this month.

Field.Name: MaximumGuildEntries
Field.Description: The elimination matches a guild may play, 0 for no limit.

Field.Name: Stones
Field.Description: The occupied stones of the guild in the eliminations.

Field.Name: Kills
Field.Description: The kills of the guild in the eliminations.

Field.Name: LevelSum
Field.Description: The level sums of the guild in the eliminations.

Field.Name: Qualification
Field.Description: 0 none, 1 semi-final in temple 1, 2 semi-final in temple 2, 3 finalist, 4 champion.

Field.Name: PlayerEntries
Field.Description: The elimination matches the character played this month.

Field.Name: MaximumPlayerEntries
Field.Description: The elimination matches a character may play, 0 for no limit.

Packet.Name: IllusionTempleStones
Packet.SentWhen: To the players of a renewed Illusion Temple when the battle starts and whenever a stone is sealed or unsealed or the Cursed Hollow changes hands.
Packet.CausedReaction: The client shows the stones, their holders and where the hollow is.

Field.Name: OwnTeam
Field.Description: The team of the player: 1 allied forces, 2 illusion forces.

Field.Name: HollowState
Field.Description: Where the Cursed Hollow is: 0 in the Cursed Statue, 1 carried, 2 on the ground, 3 none (the statue comes back).
